app.name: WebDAV Sync
app.description: Sync folders from any WebDAV server into the Cortex knowledge graph — Koofr, Hetzner Storage Share, ownCloud, and more — on demand or on a schedule, fully server-side

config.name: WEBDAV_URL
config.description: Full WebDAV collection URL including any base path, e.g. https://dav.example.com/remote.php/webdav or https://app.koofr.net/dav/Koofr (no trailing slash)

config.name: WEBDAV_USERNAME
config.description: WebDAV username (many providers use app-specific credentials - check your provider's WebDAV/app-password settings)

config.name: WEBDAV_PASSWORD
config.description: WebDAV password or app password, pasted as-is. Basic auth is assembled and base64-encoded server-side. Stored encrypted.
